description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Ed Oliver (knee) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Oliver was a full participant on Thursday after being limited by a knee issue on Wednesday. It looks like he's a full go for Week 8, which will be great news for Buffalo's defensive front ahead of a tough matchup against the Ravens.
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Ray Davis (illness) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Davis came down with an illness of some kind and wasn't able to practice on Thursday after being a full go on Wednesday. He's likely to be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game and is expected to remain nothing more than a depth piece on this offense for the foreseeable future.
items.title: Ray Davis (illness) absent from practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid (chest) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kincaid was a limited participant at practice on Thursday. This was his second-straight limited practice, which means that he could end up carrying an injury designation heading into the weekend. Friday's official injury report should give us more information on his status ahead of Week 8.
items.title: Dalton Kincaid (chest) limited participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) was limited in practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Moore is still managing a nagging shoulder issue and was limited at practice again on Thursday as a result. He is likely to play through it in Week 8 coming off of the bye week, however,  but it remains to be seen if he will carry any sort of injury designation heading into the weekend or not.
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Nick Allegretti (back) was sidelined at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Allegretti is a new addition to Washington's injury report. He is now dealing with a back issue and is at risk of being sidelined in Week 8 because of it. If he's out, Washington's offensive front will be weaker than usual in a matchup against the Eagles on Sunday.
items.title: Nick Allegretti (back) sidelined at practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to log a full practice session on Thursday. He was held out of Wednesday's practice due to a pair of issues, but neither of them are considered serious at this point. He remains a safe flex option in most league formats for the foreseeable future.
items.title: Stefon Diggs (hand/hamstring) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Treylon Burks (foot) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Burks was limited on Wednesday due to his foot issue, but he was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday. Friday's injury report should help clear up whether or not this is simply an injury management move on the part of the team.
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) downgraded to non-participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: John Bates (shoulder) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bates was not able to practice again on Thursday, which makes him unlikely to play in Week 8. He remains off of the fantasy radar either way moving forward, regardless of his health status.
items.title: John Bates (shoulder) absent from practice Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Christian Watson (chest) has been taken to the hospital for a potential chest injury. Watson was able to walk off the field, into the lockers, and into the ambulance under his own power, it sounds like it is a precautionary measure to ensure no internal damage was done. He is done for the night.
items.impact: It's a bummer to say the least for Watson, who was having a huge first half, catching six passes for 100 yards on seven targets. Hopefully he will be able to return while only missing minimal time, especially given the mini-bye Green Bay is on thanks to the Thursday game.
items.title: Christian Watson (chest) taken to hospital with chest injury

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Kyle Hamilton (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A knee issue left Hamilton absent from practice on Wednesday, but he was able to make his return to a practice in a limited fashion on Thursday. He seems to have a good chance to play on Sunday, but we likely won't know more until after practice on Friday.
items.title: Kyle Hamilton (knee) listed as limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Roquan Smith (knee) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran linebacker wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was a limited participant. He seems to be trending the right way for Week 8, but the team has yet to make an official judgement one way or the other.
items.title: Roquan Smith (knee) officially limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Simpson has been managing a groin issue for a while and was limited for another practice on Thursday as a result. He should be okay to play in Week 8, however, barring any setbacks at practice on Friday.
items.title: John Simpson (groin) limited participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Jackson was able to log a full practice session again on Thursday. Unless he suffers a setback between now and Sunday, fantasy managers should expect him to play and continue to be a must-start fantasy option moving forward.
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) practices in full Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Bobby Brown III (hand) is out against the Packers on Thursday despite being listed as questionable and having multiple practice sessions under his belt.
items.impact: It's unfortunate for the Panthers, who will be without Jaelen Phillips as well. Brown looked to be on the positive side of questionable, but in the final checks, he must have been deemed not quite ready. TeRah Edwards is listed as his backup, so he could see additional snaps, but don't expect anything big on the IDP side.
items.title: Bobby Brown III (hand) out against Packers on Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Sean Rhyan (ankle) is out against the Panthers on Thursday night.
items.impact: With Rhyan out, the Packers will turn to John Williams at center. It will make things a little more difficult for Jordan Love and Josh Jacobs, but Carolina's defensive front, while it can make plays, isn't the most fearsome unit either.
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) out against Panthers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Zaire Franklin (leg) is out for the Packers Thursday Night Football game against the Panthers.
items.impact: This is unsurprising given his leg injury, as he was expected to miss some time, albeit not enough for the team to place him on IR. He will get a "bye week" thanks to the TNF game, giving him extra time to rest up, so he may only miss two games when all is said and done.
items.title: Zaire Franklin (leg) out against Panthers on Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) is active for the Packers' game against the Panthers on Thursday night.
items.impact: Golden was initially questionable coming into the contest, but there was optimism that he would play. That turned out to be the case, and he will suit up against the Panthers. He should be started against a defense lacking its top two corners.
items.title: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) active for TNF against Carolina

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited at another practice on Thursday. He's still managing a foot issue, but it's not likely to leave him sidelined in Week 8, so he should continue to hold things down on the right side of New England's offensive line this week.
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson was a non-participant on practice due to an illness that he's managing.
items.impact: Henderson missed Thursday's practice, and now we know that it was an illness that left him sidelined. He's likely day-to-day for the time being and seems to have a good chance to suit up and play in Week 8.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson dealing with an illness

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Calvin Ridley (hip) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for another practice on Thursday, as he's still dealing with a hip issue of some kind. We should know more about his official status for Week 8 after practice on Friday.
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) limited participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Josiah Trotter (illness) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Trotter wasn't able to practice on Wednesday due to the illness that he was dealing with, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be a full go for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Falcons.
items.title: Josiah Trotter (illness) returns to full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Luke Goedeke (calf) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Goedeke was absent from another practice on Thursday as he continues to manage a lingering calf issue. It looks like he's going to be sidelined in Week 8, which will leave Tampa Bay's offensive front weaker than usual against Atlanta.
items.title: Luke Goedeke (calf) absent from practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell (hip) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Gainwell was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday, which was an upgrade after he missed Wednesday's practice with a hip issue. He seems likely to play in Week 8 but will continue to be a depth piece on this offense even if active against the Falcons.
items.title: Kenny Gainwell (hip) officially limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Egbuka was limited again on Thursday as he continues to deal with a pair of injuries. He was able to shed his red non-contact jersey, however, which indicates that he is progressing well at this point. Friday's injury report should give us more clarity on whether or not he will be ready to go in time for Week 8.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) limited participant Thursday
